response.message: What effect do you want from the feather touching Whisker, rather than an effect you think I expect? In your latest versions, what difference does slight versus stronger friction make for the reader? Would thinking longer resolve which wording serves your intended effect, or would a small revision and rereading provide better evidence? What thinking or writing step do you choose and carry out next? What observation would make you change that choice? What finding from the written passage, remaining uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into your following turn?
response.rationale: The child repeats coaching questions without advancing the scene. Redirect attention to an actual textual contrast and independent judgment, connecting the chosen step to observable writing.
